method: Official public documentation read through web search/open; no provider account resource provisioning or billed inference tests. Engineering recommendations are distinguished from measured results.

sources.title: Codex non-interactive execution
sources.relevance: CLI scripts, JSON events, resume; saved authentication and automation-specific constraints.

sources.title: Codex authentication
sources.relevance: ChatGPT subscription versus API-key access, headless device flow; account readiness must be proved on target host.

sources.title: ChatGPT plan usage and self-hosted VMs
sources.relevance: Documented protected credential transfer/host identity; eligibility and hosted-app restrictions remain.

sources.title: Agents API overview
sources.relevance: Managed Codex harness, durable sessions, model/tool/container API billing.

sources.title: Agents API session webhooks
sources.relevance: Signed lifecycle callbacks; idle/action_required can wake application controller.

sources.title: Agents sandbox lifecycle
sources.relevance: Session can outlive environment; application-owned compute reconciliation for self-hosted environments.

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers limits
sources.relevance: Request lifetime is not durable autonomy; waitUntil extension bounded after response/disconnect.

sources.title: Cloudflare Workflows limits
sources.relevance: Durable waits; lifetime conditional on step/CPU/state/instance limits; eventual rollover required.

sources.title: Durable Objects alarms
sources.relevance: Persistent wake-ups with at-least-once delivery and retries; deduplication required.

sources.title: Cloudflare Containers lifecycle
sources.relevance: External Linux compute, lifecycle distinct from durable control; deployment/access not present in current Sites manifest.

sources.title: Cloud Run resource model
sources.relevance: Distinguishes request services, jobs and worker pools; persistent worker compute is a specific resource mode.

sources.title: Temporal worker deployment
sources.relevance: Worker hosting, replay/recovery and Continue-As-New; cloud service does not imply activities are hosted for you.

sources.title: Trigger.dev product documentation
sources.relevance: Managed task execution, waits, concurrency and retries; retry from beginning versus checkpoint semantics require correct decomposition.

sources.title: Inngest durable execution
sources.relevance: Event-driven durable functions and memoized steps; choose hosting/compute for functions.

sources.title: n8n queue mode
sources.relevance: Workflow routing still requires worker processes/Redis and model access.

sources.title: ChatGPT scheduled tasks
sources.relevance: Scheduled/triggered tasks exist; documentation is not proof of an indefinite campaign with successful handoffs.

sources.title: GitHub Actions limits and scheduling
sources.relevance: GitHub-hosted job limits; schedule delay/dropped runs documented separately in troubleshooting-workflows.

sources.title: Browser offline/background lifetime
sources.relevance: Service worker tasks may be stopped if too long; mobile page is not an uptime guarantee.

sources.title: Render free deployment limits
sources.relevance: Free services may spin down; background-worker mode and paid-resource eligibility are distinct.

sources.title: AWS Step Functions
sources.relevance: Standard/Express workflow lifetimes and external activities; standard Lambda invocation timeout is not the lifetime of a durable workflow.

sources.title: Azure Durable Functions
sources.relevance: Orchestration, checkpoints, retries and recovery with activities on configured compute.

sources.title: LangGraph architecture and checkpoints
sources.relevance: Graph and checkpoint mechanics; framework persistence does not itself provide a host.

sources.title: Ollama FAQ
sources.relevance: Local model/runtime considerations; quality, hardware capacity and uptime require separate tests.

sources.title: Trigger Workspace Agent runs
sources.relevance: Native programmatic trigger option for eligible published agents; current account access not tested.

sources.title: Responses background mode
sources.relevance: Asynchronous model execution; application still owns continuation policy and external work.

sources.title: Usage limits and shared allowances
sources.relevance: Subscription model usage varies; allowance is not an unlimited continuous-inference commitment.

sources.title: ChatGPT plan usage restrictions
sources.relevance: Open-source/local application flow; remotely hosted/paid distribution has separate access requirements.

sources.title: GitHub schedule caveats
sources.relevance: Scheduled jobs can be delayed/dropped under load.

sources.title: Standard Lambda timeout
sources.relevance: Standard invocation maximum 900 seconds; do not generalize that to all AWS managed execution modes.

sites_capability_reference.source: sites skill recurring-updates and current native Sites tool schemas
sites_capability_reference.finding: Current schedule operation links a cloud task. Current Site manifest exposes D1/MCP, not an observed native workflow/queue/DO binding. Generic Cloudflare documentation is not proof such bindings are available through Sites.
